column1: # Ash Jenna's two fights: the optional super boss in Vale and the one at Suhalla Gate.

column3: You came back.\nDoes this place still\nfeel like home?{end_wait}
Neither did the dead.\nBut here we are.\nDraw your sword.{end_wait}
You beat me.\nVale still burned.\nRemember that.{end_wait}
I asked them to move.\nThey drew their swords.\nNow look at them.{end_wait}
You hurt them\nbecause they stood\nin your way?{end_wait}
They made a choice.\nNow make yours.\nFight or turn back.{end_wait}
Go on. Help them.\nYou'll never reach\neveryone in time.{end_wait}
